table.name: TLGNS_SAP_MATERIAL_DESCRIPTION
table.description: Material Descriptions from SAP. Contains language-dependent descriptions for materials and is modelled like the _TX reference tables, i.e. with a compound primary kay (ID, LANG_CD).

column.name: SAP_MATERIAL_ID
column.description: Part of PK. FK to TLGNS_SAP_MATERIAL.

column.name: LANG_CD
column.description: Part of PK. FK to TLGNR_LANG_BS. Language from SAP (material_short_texts (MAKT) / SPRAS_ISO). 'Z1' is mapped to 'de'.

column.name: TXT
column.description: Description of the material in the language LANG_CD from SAP (material_short_texts (MAKT) / MAKTX).
